apps.name: Resona
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music client in Material 3 Expressive
apps.localizedDescription: Resona is a YouTube Music client for iPhone and iPad with dynamic cover colours, word-synced karaoke lyrics, downloads and a Material 3 Expressive design.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Saved tracks (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): Spotify 'Liked Songs' with the existing Spotify login (GraphQL fetchLibraryTracks), matched to YouTube Music on play (duration-aware, cached) and queued progressively; library tile when Spotify is connected; tests
- Docs: Feather (round 10) [skip ci]

- Updates via Feather: 'Install in Feather' opens feather://install/<ipa> (scheme verified in Feather's source), fallback downloads the IPA with progress and opens the share sheet; 'Add source to Feather' in About; ESign texts → Feather (banner, About, README, CI comments); tests

- Podcasts (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): episode search on podcast pages; docs A8; tests
- Library (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): export playlists as CSV (share sheet, Excel-safe UTF-8), local music imported from the Files app with metadata and cover, playing offline like downloads; tests

- Fix: lastSeenKey nonisolated
- Fix: OnboardingState.isExistingInstall nonisolated for unit tests
- Fix: PlaybackErrorCenter.describe nonisolated (unit tests call it synchronously)
- Stats (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): listening statistics per period (minutes, plays, streak, top artists / songs / albums, time of day + listener type, weekdays), recap stories with artwork wall and count-up, share the summary as image, non-destructive undoable reset; tests
- Home (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): staggered genre tiles with their own shapes, 'Discover genres' on Home (daily pick), genre pages with colour header, featured cards for the first playlist shelf and the community shelf, more varied Quick Picks; tests
- Player (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): Editorial style (die-cut cover morphing squircle ↔ scalloped disc, serif headline, bento controls), Immersive style (full-screen canvas or turning cover disc), 'Blurred cover' background, rotate-cover switch, artist picker for several artists, codec + sample rate in the audio details, artwork placeholder; docs; tests
- App (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): 'What's new' after an update from the GitHub release notes (New / Improved / Fixed, all versions since the last seen one, also in Settings → About), first-launch onboarding with optional YouTube Music sign-in, update banner shows the sorted notes; tests
- Queue (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): YouTube recommendation chips replace the upcoming songs, 'Play next' moves the song (swipe right or row menu), multi-select with play next / remove, empty state; tests
- Playback (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): playback stream resolution before downloads, 'preload next song' switch, 'prevent audio interruptions' (mix with other apps, session + mpv consistent), SponsorBlock skip button mode + per-song switch in the player menu, visible playback error banner with cause hint and copyable details; tests

- Credits: ArchiveTune (rukamori & contributors) in About and docs/CREDITS.md
- Lyrics (round 10 / ArchiveTune 15): Binimum provider, enhanced LRC word times on repeated lines, per-song offset ±5 s, AI translation via OpenRouter (own key in Keychain, model, own prompt, test) with fallback, translation source shown; tests
- Docs: round 10 plan (ArchiveTune canary features, Resona for Android)

- Fix optional chaining in the Deezer lyrics parser
- Docs: round 9 progress
- Lyrics accounts: Deezer (web login reads the ARL cookie, or paste; JWT + pipe GraphQL with word/line sync; Keychain only, sign out, expiry → 'sign in again') and Musixmatch with the user's own token (desktop API, falls back to guest); settings section with status and 'create free account'; tests
- Full-screen lyrics: status bar + home indicator hidden, ✕/⋯ hidden until a tap on a free area (3 s), both as lyrics settings (default on); UI test reveals the buttons by a header tap

- UI test: drop jump checked via the elapsed time; test report: drop menu proof screenshots
- Docs: round 8 progress
- More lyrics sources: SimpMusic and Unison (per YouTube upload — remixes/edits), Megalobiz, QQ Music; candidates with title/artist/duration, version-aware ranking; manual search lists every hit (provider, title, artist, duration, sync type, 'this version') and offers AI calibration after a pick; tests
- Drop menu: plain buttons only (the Toggle took the app-wide custom toggle style); UI test proves both entries (screenshot, curve hides/shows, jump toast)

- Docs: round 7 progress
- AI for every song: synced lyrics are calibrated (robust Theil–Sen fit of tempo + offset from confident anchors, stored per song, shown under the label), otherwise synced; remixes: partial sync of every sung line occurrence, lyrics from audio, clear message with options; slowed/sped-up: calibration offer / automatic on Wi-Fi (setting); tests
- Drop menu rebuilt as a plain system menu (inherited button style broke its items): jump + curve toggle, tap still jumps
- Docs: test report with UI screenshots (no lyrics), device findings rounds 5–6
- Landscape side panel: action tile labels on two lines, queue chips stack when they don't fit (were cut off with …); UI test closes the sleep timer dialog via Cancel
- UI tests: collapse the player robustly (wide layout has no chevron), tolerant taps on search results
- UI tests: lyrics opened once and closed by swiping (coordinates), ✕ only as fallback
- UI tests: close diagnostics (frame, screenshot), swipe fallback for lyrics
- Simulator tests: skip XCTest's automatic screen recordings in the export (artifact was 1 GB)

- Docs: round 6 progress
- Crossfade dropouts: audio session identical to mpv's iOS output (no mode/policy flip-flop), fixed 48 kHz stereo float output so outputs stay open across files, faded instance parked on silence instead of stopped (no setActive(NO)), spare warmed up on creation, timestamped logs; revive only as watchdog
- AI sync: larger model tried automatically below 30 %, aligner more tolerant (phonetic similarity for longer words, sung spellings, digits as words, threshold 0.5); tests
- AI lyrics: outlier anchors dropped (longest non-decreasing run) and interpolated, strictly increasing word/line times; lyrics never jump backwards (monotonic timing on load); tests with scrambled times
- Slowed: cross-check the original length with the original's YouTube Music audio track (used when within 6 % of LRCLIB, both logged); tempo fine tuning ±0.01 in the lyrics menu
- Most-replayed curve can be switched off: long press on the drop button (menu) or Settings → Playback; default on

- UI tests: close lyrics that are already open, wait for the close button, safe attachment names; export: always .png, rotation errors don't abort
- Docs: round 5 progress
- AI sync: ffmpeg with CA bundle/user agent/timeout for streams, no-speech window skipping off (singing), whole-song diagnostics per 30 s; end-to-end test on synthetic say speech
- Crossfade (device): clean stop of the faded instance (volume 0, drain, pause, stop), re-activate the audio session that mpv's iOS audio output deactivates on shutdown, restart the active AudioUnit only if it stalled, watchdog with ao-reload, audio state logs
- Slowed lyrics: tempo diagnosis (logged, shown under 'Lyrics from'), original length also via title + lyrics match (re-uploads credited to the channel), hand-picked/refetched provider lyrics get the check too, cache v3; fix inverted slowed/sped-up note
- Lyrics: swipe down on handle/header to close (follows the finger, 25 % or flick, springs back); UI test for it
- Lyrics: translation, background vocals and romanization wrap fully (were truncated with …)
- UI tests: no automatic update check (banner covered the account menu)
- Full-screen lyrics: controls always visible, auto-hide as opt-in setting; title and artist left-aligned
- UI tests: lyrics close diagnostics (app log + per-attempt screenshots), wake landscape chrome; test.yml inputs for single tests / skipping crossfade

- Simulator tests: retry package resolution; test report draft with crossfade diagrams
- UI tests: query buttons only (any-type query timed out in the lyrics view)
- UI tests: tap the visible element when an id exists twice; video as its own artifact
- UI tests: close buttons of lyrics/queue/menu overlays get identifiers
- UI tests: local test tone instead of YouTube stream (CI IPs get a bot check), artist back button id; crossfade analysis: continuous clock, instance role swap, pause handling
- Equalizer: preset chips wrap instead of being cut off at the column edge
- Crossfade: equal power through mpv's cubic volume curve (measured -6 dB dip); test fixes: cleanup, song tap, export names, landscape rotation
- Docs: round 4 progress [skip ci]
- Split playlist: genre/mood grouping from Last.fm tags (cached, API key only), tests
- Simulator test workflow: iPad sim build, unit+UI tests, video, screenshots, crossfade measurement
- Unit + UI tests (placeholder texts only), testable tempo/scroll/split helpers, result identifiers
- Test hooks: accessibility identifiers, TestMode (ao=null), DEBUG crossfade harness
- Docs: progress file for round 4 [skip ci]
- CI: don't build/release for documentation-only pushes [skip ci]
- Docs: round 3 finished (v0.8.3, v0.8.4)

- Docs: progress round 3 - points 7 and 8, limitations, test list
- PlaylistTools: import GRDB for statement arguments
- Lyrics: sync with AI (WhisperKit, on-device) + forced alignment
- Smart downloads (optional, off by default)
- Docs: progress round 3 - points 4 to 6
- Playlist tools: automatic playlists, save, split, remove duplicates
- Lyrics: on-device translation into German
- Player: 'Most replayed' wave and 'Jump to the drop'

- Docs: progress round 3 - shortcuts done
- AppRouter: shortcut actions on the main actor
- iPad keyboard shortcuts
- Docs: progress round 3 - crossfade and sleep timer done
- Sleep timer: fade the volume out before it pauses
- Crossfade: two equivalent mpv instances (A/B) instead of a tail handover
- Docs: progress file for round 3

- Settings: same header on every page, 'Wiedergabe' everywhere
- Crossfade: explicit self in the ramp log closure
- Crossfade: verified tail with the main player's options, detailed logs

- Lyrics: plain text instead of fake [00:00.00] timing, sync it yourself
- Settings: hide the lyrics developer switches behind 7 taps on the version
- Appearance: player style (large cover / small cover + lyrics), blur strength
- Songtext settings: animation style, translation, romanization
- Storage settings: delete all downloads, clear caches with sizes
- iPad: queue, player menu and lyrics options as a side panel
- Artists: chevron instead of play on cards, 'Play mix' on the artist page
- Downloads: keep downloaded playlists up to date
- Rename the player AirPlay button (clashed with Trop's AirPlayButton)
- Lyrics: fix timing for slowed/sped-up versions, per-song tempo and offset
- Playback: crossfade between songs (off / 1-12 s)
- Lock screen / Control Center: like, shuffle, repeat, AirPlay, safer pauses
- Auto releases on every main build, ESign/AltStore app source, update check
- iPad: lyrics full screen with cover, controls and rest mode
